name: Road to De Other Side: the hostile Bat of the Other Side uses its own Heroic and Mythic templates
contract: Bat of the Other Side (162766 and 162767) was the last hostile Road creature without Heroic/Mythic templates, so
it fought with its Normal melee on every difficulty. It now has level 60 copies at entry + 100000 / + 200000 like
Road's other trash. No log has a bat hit, so Heroic is its Normal DamageModifier (0.781) times 1.544, the median
Heroic / Normal of Road's trash, and Mythic is Heroic x 2.5: 1.206 and 3.015, about 143 and 357 per blow to a
level 60 player at 118.3 per point for class 1 (see custom-dungeons-heroic-mythic-melee). Health stays with
coa_dungeon_health: 42308 on Heroic and 55000 on Mythic.

steps.label: CONTROL: Road to De Other Side on Mythic
